tasks.short: Prepare political science teaching materials, teach students and record learning follow-up.

steps.what: Retrieve political science readings, examples and existing teaching materials
Plan the explanation, discussion questions and learning sequence
Write lesson slides, examples and discussion worksheets
Check materials and teach political science through explanation and discussion
Record class progress, misconceptions and subsequent teaching needs

tasks.design: Use native source folders and lesson templates in {DOCS}, with class follow-up fields in {LMS}. Planning, explanation and discussion stay human; materials writing and the later progress record have separate effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation and material formatting surround direct teaching.
tasks.enabler_now: Native teaching templates and records can reuse structure and selected references.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining contested concepts and recognising student misunderstanding.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher adapts examples and responds to the actual discussion.
tasks.altitude: Make preparation easier while preserving direct intellectual teaching.

reach.learn: Keep learning needs connected to subsequent lesson planning

evidence.claim: Native lesson templates and course views can reduce repeated preparation and record handling; no measured political-science teaching saving is supplied.

assumptions: Includes ordinary lesson preparation, actual teaching and its progress record; no examination or grade automation is added.
Scientist produces selected readings and teaching plan in s1-s2, materials in s3 and observed learning needs in s4-s5, with capture counted. Unclear source versions are checked manually.
Native folders, templates and progress fields first; no automated student assessment or hidden LMS publishing action.
Ordinary record saves remain in retained time without self-approval.
unknowns: Existing lesson templates and current class record practice
research_questions: How much preparation is repeated structure rather than new intellectual explanation?

already_counted.description: Capture observed class progress and future teaching needs

approvals.approved_version: Exact lesson materials and cited examples for this class; changed claims require checking before teaching.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=90, gross=10, upkeep=2, central net=8 E1. Low: new course content lacks suitable templates and needs bespoke worksheets, retaining 97 hours plus upkeep for 1 net. High: recurring course structure permits partial template reuse while explanations and discussion stay fully human, retaining 93 hours plus upkeep for 5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Track government policy decisions, read authoritative sources and maintain checked knowledge notes.

steps.what: Maintain the government policy source list, coverage topics and date filters
Collect new government policy decisions from the specified sources
Read decisions and assess significance, status and political context
Write current knowledge notes with decision status, dates and source references
Check coverage gaps and distinguish decisions from proposals or commentary
outputs: checked current knowledge and unresolved gaps

tasks.design: Configure official publication feeds and saved topic views in {DATA_PLATFORM}, with reference-linked notes in {DOCS}. Collection is its own deterministic read step; the scientist reads the decisions, interprets their status and checks coverage.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated checking of publication sources competes with substantive reading.
tasks.enabler_now: Official feeds and date-filtered views can collect references without generating political analysis.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising meaningful policy changes and interpreting their implementation status.
tasks.human_edge: Knowledge requires understanding, not merely receiving a digest.
tasks.altitude: Reduce source monitoring while retaining substantive policy reading.

reach.learn: Distinguish enacted decisions from proposed measures

evidence.claim: Official-feed collection and dated source views can reduce repeated monitoring; this is an unmeasured E1 scenario.

assumptions: Includes coverage maintenance, collection, reading, note writing and coverage checking; no saving on understanding the decisions.

Scientist produces source URL or feed identity, topic, jurisdiction and date filters in s1, with full capture effort. Official publisher supplies document ID, title, date and status in the existing publication metadata; absent metadata or inaccessible feeds require manual source checking.
Native subscriptions and saved views first; no model summary, generated political claim or implied notification send.
Ordinary knowledge-note saves stay retained without self-approval.
unknowns: Official feed availability and coverage of nonstandard decisions
research_questions: Which monitored sources expose stable decision identifiers and status metadata?

incremental.description: Maintain feed mappings and inspect failed collection

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=71, gross=29, upkeep=5, central net=24 E1. Low: key decisions appear on poorly structured pages without stable status metadata, retaining 92 hours plus upkeep for 3 net. High: most official sources have compatible feeds but unusual jurisdictions still need manual monitoring, retaining 80 hours plus upkeep for 15 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and test political theories with traceable documentary, interview and statistical evidence.

steps.what: Develop theories, testable implications and an appropriate research design
Retrieve newspapers, periodicals, case law, historical papers, polls and statistical sources
Conduct interviews and clarify evidence relevant to theoretical propositions
Record interview accounts, documentary references and comparable evidence fields
Test theories against evidence, alternatives and methodological limitations
Write the theory-testing record, findings and unresolved alternatives

tasks.design: Configure source views in {DATA_PLATFORM} and reference-linked evidence and test-record templates in {DOCS}. Theory creation, interviewing and testing stay human, while the interview record is separately captured and priced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence navigation and inconsistent research records add handling around theoretical work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native evidence tables can preserve source references and reduce repeated formatting.
tasks.still_hard: Theory quality, identification and weighing contradictory evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher develops meaningful alternatives and judges what the evidence can support.
tasks.altitude: Strengthen research traceability without substituting generated theories for inquiry.

reach.learn: Keep accounts and source references separate from interpretation

evidence.claim: Native reference views and research record templates may reduce repeated handling; no measured theory-development saving is supplied.

assumptions: Includes theoretical design, source retrieval, interviewing, the separate evidence record, testing and written findings.

Scientist produces participant/source ID, date, quotation or observation reference, variable definition and limitation in s4, with capture time counted. Missing source or incompatible definitions require manual reconciliation.
Native reference and record templates first; existing statistical analysis within testing is retained, with no new machine action or saving claimed.
Ordinary research-record saves remain retained and need no self-approval.
unknowns: Evidence comparability and present research record structure
research_questions: How much record work is repeated referencing versus interpretive analysis?

incremental.description: Maintain evidence fields and test-record templates

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=91, gross=9, upkeep=3, central net=6 E1. Low: historical evidence lacks comparable definitions and interview records require bespoke contextualisation, retaining 97 hours plus upkeep for zero net. High: stable source metadata permits reference reuse while interpretation and testing remain manual, retaining 93 hours plus upkeep for 4 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write and disseminate research results through checked publications, reports and presentations.

steps.what: Capture final research findings, tables, source references and dissemination requirements
Write publications, reports or presentation prose from the research brief

loop.purpose: Draft explanatory text around fixed research findings
loop.input: Final findings, tables, references and audience requirements
loop.output: Draft with each substantive claim linked to a supplied finding or reference
loop.check: Scientist checks every citation, number, inference and caveat against the brief
loop.stop: One revision; unresolved citation or unsupported interpretation triggers manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates give structure but cannot explain each study's distinct argument

steps.what: Format research tables and reference lists for the selected output template
Revise the argument and verify research claims, references and disclosure limits
Save the final research dissemination package in its existing document location
Check and submit the final publication or written report to its destination
Check the final presentation and disseminate results to the public audience

tasks.design: Use native table and reference styles in {DOCS}, then bounded prose drafting from a captured research brief. Scientific revision, ordinary saving, submission through {PARTNER_PORTAL} or {EMAIL}, and public presentation remain separate steps with final-version checks on each dissemination action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing and formatting research outputs repeatedly draws on the same result pack.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic styles and constrained prose drafts can reuse final results without changing them.
tasks.still_hard: Argument quality, research integrity and explaining limitations to the audience.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher stands behind the study and answers criticism.
tasks.altitude: Reduce output assembly so scientific revision receives more attention.

reach.learn: Keep output prose connected to fixed evidence

evidence.claim: The digest reports a government report containing fabricated references, reinforcing direct citation checking.
Template formatting and bounded prose drafting may reduce output preparation; the proposed benefit is unmeasured.

assumptions: Shares represent a typical mix of written and presentation outputs, not a requirement to use both channels for every study.

Scientist produces final finding, number, unit, source identifier, caveat and destination/style requirement in s1; full capture is retained. Missing citation metadata or unsupported claims return to manual preparation.
Native styles and reference manager first; model use is confined to own research prose and approved data access.
Ordinary same-system save s5 is fully retained without approval; actual submission and presentation have separate final-version gates.
unknowns: Output template compatibility and correction effort for drafts
research_questions: Does drafting reduce total writing and factual correction time for actual research outputs?

already_counted.description: Capture final findings and source-linked brief

incremental.description: Maintain style specifications and inspect draft grounding

approvals.approved_version: Exact final document, tables, references, disclosure scope and destination; any changed content or destination requires a fresh submission check.
Exact final presentation, claims and qualifications for the intended public audience; changed material requires checking before delivery.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=72.5, gross=27.5, upkeep=5, central net=22.5 E1. Low: unusual journal structure and incomplete citation metadata force prose and reference rebuilding, retaining 92 hours plus upkeep for 3 net. High: compatible output styles and a complete evidence brief enable partial drafting and formatting reuse while argument revision stays human, retaining 80 hours plus upkeep for 15 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Protect intellectual research and teaching while improving source and output preparation.
reach: Share traceable evidence practices with teachers and policy researchers
role.ambitious_version: A political scientist with more attention for explanation, theoretical inquiry and defensible public communication.
